nodes.description: AccessControl private mapping bytes32 => RoleData storing role members and admin roles
Constant role identifier keccak256("MINTER_ROLE") required to mint receipt tokens
Constant role identifier keccak256("BURNER_ROLE") required to burn receipt tokens
Constant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (0x00) that administers all roles
ERC20 private mapping of account balances modified on mint/burn
ERC20 private total supply counter modified on mint/burn
ReceiptToken constructor: initializes ERC20 name/symbol and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender
Public mint(address to, uint256 amount) guarded by MINTER_ROLE check
Public burn(address from, uint256 amount) guarded by BURNER_ROLE check
AccessControl hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) membership check
ERC20 internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount) increasing supply and balance
ERC20 internal _burn(address account, uint256 amount) decreasing supply and balance
AccessControl grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) admin-only role assignment
msg.sender controlled by the caller and used for role/account checks
State mutation minting tokens: _totalSupply and _balances incremented
State mutation burning tokens: _balances and _totalSupply decremented
Parameter to of mint() receiving the minted tokens
Parameter amount of mint() giving the amount minted
Parameter from of burn() whose tokens are burned
Parameter amount of burn() giving the amount burned

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the account argument to hasRole to verify the caller holds the required role
hasRole require statement gates entry into mint, reverting when the caller lacks MINTER_ROLE
hasRole require statement gates entry into burn, reverting when the caller lacks BURNER_ROLE
MINTER_ROLE constant is used as the role argument in the hasRole check inside mint
BURNER_ROLE constant is used as the role argument in the hasRole check inside burn
mint forwards to the internal _mint implementation after the access check passes
burn forwards to the internal _burn implementation after the access check passes
_mint performs the balance and total supply increment mutation
_burn performs the balance and total supply decrement mutation
mint parameter to flows into _mint as the credited account
mint parameter amount flows into _mint as the minted amount
burn parameter from flows into _burn as the debited account
burn parameter amount flows into _burn as the burned amount
mint declares and consumes its amount parameter
burn declares and consumes its amount parameter
msg.sender is granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE inside the constructor, making the deployer privileged
DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is passed to _setupRole in the constructor
grantRole uses hasRole to verify the caller holds the role's admin role
grantRole checks _msgSender() derived from msg.sender before assigning roles
_balances storage is read and written by the minting mutation
_totalSupply storage is read and incremented by the minting mutation
_balances storage is read and written by the burning mutation
_totalSupply storage is read and decremented by the burning mutation
_roles mapping is read by hasRole to resolve role membership

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter to only exists to feed mint and has no independent semantic identity; fold into the mint function node
Parameter amount is scoped to mint and drives its state mutation; fold into the mint function node
Parameter from only exists to feed burn and has no independent semantic identity; fold into the burn function node
Parameter amount is scoped to burn and drives its state mutation; fold into the burn function node
